title: Hold passenger liability insurance (air carriers)
what: Air carriers must be covered by acceptable insurance, or adequate financial arrangements, for their liability to passengers.

sources.title: Civil Aviation (Carriers' Liability) Act 1959
sources.quote: 41E Carriers to be covered by acceptable insurance (1) A person (other than a person who is, or is an agent of, the Crown in any capacity) must not engage in, or propose to engage in, a passenger-carrying operation, unless an acceptable contract of insurance in relation to the operation is in force.

reach.condition: if it carries passengers by air
